meta.notes: Falcon Hub Airways (fictional). v2 history weeks 0-103 under P0. Options evaluated at request time from information available then (stock before the request, open POs/ROs at quoted dates, published AOG-route odds; never the per-request draws). Material shortage exposure = expected material-related downtime hours (wait beyond the rectification window + fitting/RTS) x rate/h + fixed cost per event (if late) + direct cost; exposure_aed already includes direct_cost. Robbery = engineering/quality approval required, human decision, never ranked. Rectification windows are hypothetical, not operator MEL decisions.

caveats: Request-level hours and exposure (each late request carries the fixed event cost); incident totals merge overlapping requests per aircraft.
The best option is chosen ex ante from quoted dates and published route odds; the history's own route outcomes are single draws from the same odds.

Probabilistic routes and the repair queue-jump keep their expected value ex post (not observed for that request); transfers are deterministic; 'await inbound' uses the actual arrival, re-planned at the quoted date.
Robbery is never ranked as a recommendation, so requests history covered by robbery compare against the best non-robbery option.
